inBharatSovereignDesc: भारत के लिए, यहां के बिल्डरों द्वारा बनाया। आपका डेटा, आपका नियंत्रण।
inBharatTrustedBy: भारत के लिए वॉइस-फर्स्ट, बहु-भाषा AI—एक ही जगह खोजें, बनाएं और तर्क करें।
inBharatCapabilitiesSub: सही तरह का जवाब पाने के लिए मोड बदलें—रिसर्च, क्रिएटिव, कोड, या रियल-टाइम वेब।
inBharatStandardDesc: आपकी भाषा में सामान्य चैट और तर्क।
inBharatResearchDesc: सत्यापित स्रोतों और उद्धरणों के साथ गहन खोज।
inBharatCoderDesc: कोड सहायता, लॉजिक और तकनीकी उत्तर।
inBharatBrowserDesc: रियल-टाइम वेब सर्च और वर्तमान जानकारी।
inBharatVsSub: India-first, वॉइस-फर्स्ट, और भारतीय भाषाओं के लिए बना।
inBharatWhy1: वॉइस इन और आउट—बोलकर पूछें, जवाब सुनें।
inBharatWhy2: कई इंटेलिजेंस मोड—रिसर्च, कोडर, शिक्षक, ब्राउज़र।
inBharatWhy3: भारतीय भाषाएं—हिंदी, तमिल, तेलुगु, और अधिक।
inBharatWhy5: भारत के लिए बना—India-first और गोपनीयता-जागरूक।
inBharatStep1Desc: अपना सवाल टाइप करें या Speak to type इस्तेमाल करें; चाहें तो इमेज अटैच करें।
inBharatStep2Desc: InBharat खोजता है, तर्क करता है, और मोड के अनुसार स्रोत उद्धृत करता है।
inBharatStep3Desc: टेक्स्ट में जवाब पाएं; वॉइस प्लेबैक के लिए Listen टैप करें।
inBharatSecuritySub: आपकी बातचीत आपके नियंत्रण में रहती है। हम आपके डेटा पर ट्रेन नहीं करते।

servicesTitle: What We Build for Your Business
servicesDesc: We design, build, and deploy AI-powered tools, automations, and websites — so your business runs smarter and grows faster.
servicesTellUs: Tell us your problem. We'll build the solution.
serviceWebsitesDesc: Modern, fast, AI-ready websites and landing pages built to convert visitors into clients.
serviceChatbotsDesc: Custom AI chatbots for customer support, lead capture, and sales — on your website or WhatsApp.
serviceAutomationDesc: Automate repetitive tasks, approvals, data entry, and multi-step processes with AI.
serviceCRMDesc: Custom CRM systems, admin panels, and analytics dashboards for real-time business visibility.
serviceWhatsAppDesc: Automated follow-ups, drip sequences, and two-way conversations on WhatsApp and email.
serviceCallingDesc: AI-powered voice agents that handle inbound queries, qualify leads, and escalate to humans.
serviceSalesDesc: End-to-end lead capture, qualification, nurturing, and follow-up systems that work around the clock.
serviceCustomDesc: Bespoke AI tools designed for your exact workflow — from document processing to intelligent decision support.
chatAdvisor: Chat with our AI advisor — describe what you need, get a custom recommendation.
openSourceTitle: Built in public, free to use
openSourceDesc: These are open source projects we've built and released for the community.
codeinProDesc: Open-source AI coding IDE with 13 autonomous agents, 60+ LLM providers, and 22 Indian languages. Local-first — your code stays on your machine. Available as an Electron app, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin.
agentArcadeDesc: Universal AI agent observability platform. Watch, debug, and control agents from any framework in real time — execution traces, session replay, cost analytics, and human-in-the-loop remote control.
phoringDesc: Open-source decision intelligence platform. Upload documents → build a knowledge graph → run multi-agent OASIS simulations → get source-cited forecast reports with multi-AI consensus validation.
sahaayakDesc: Multilingual personal AI OS for Bharat. AI chat with memory, voice I/O, OCR scanner, smart notes, reminders, Gmail inbox, and live news — all in 13 Indian languages.
seeAllGitHub: See all our open source work on GitHub
productsDesc: These are AI tools and platforms we've built — each solves a real problem for a real audience.
workWithUsTitle: Ready to Build Your AI-Powered Business?

servingBusinesses: Serving businesses across India — in English, Hindi, and 12+ regional languages.
